screens.description: Dense ledger grouped by day with direction, search, account, and date filters, and the selected transaction open in a detail panel.

screens.name: Send payment
screens.description: Focused three-step payment flow: choose source, recipient, amount, and rail; approve with a one-time code; then confirm. The error state blocks a payment larger than the source balance.
implementationHints: Keep the summary in sync with every field; block review while the amount exceeds the source balance.
